entries.name: IDEX_API_KEY
entries.description: The API key IDEX issues for the Onsite feed. It names the account and isn't secret on its own.
howToGet: Ask the IDEX account manager to turn on the Onsite feed add-on for the trading subscription.
Set the feed's filters and markups on IDEX, then copy the API key IDEX issues for it.

entries.name: IDEX_API_SECRET
entries.description: The API secret that comes with that key. KaratOS sends it only to IDEX's Onsite feed addresses.
howToGet: Copy the API secret IDEX issues with the key.
Put it straight into the instance's Railway variables. Never send it by chat or email.

entries.name: IDEX_FEEDS
entries.description: Which Onsite feeds to read: natural, lab_grown, or both comma-separated. Defaults to natural; the lab-grown feed is a separate IDEX add-on.
howToGet: Leave unset for the natural feed only.
Add lab_grown once IDEX has turned on the lab-grown add-on.

entries.name: IDEX_MAX_STONES
entries.description: The most stones one feed may hold before the sync stops and asks for narrower filters on IDEX. Defaults to 50000.
howToGet: Raise it only if the feed's filters on IDEX are meant to cover more stones.
